newsitem.title: JAPAN: Stable forex markets desirable -- Japan EPA's Aso.
newsitem.headline: Stable forex markets desirable -- Japan EPA's Aso.

text.p: Stable foreign exchange markets are desirable, Economic Planning Agency Minister Taro Aso told a news conference on Friday.

Asked about Thursday's volatile currency fluctuations, in which the dollar moved more than 4-1/2 yen during Tokyo trading time, Aso said that excessive volatility in currency movements meant it was difficult for firms to plan ahead and that currency markets should be stable.
Asked about the fall-off in consumer spending after the rise in the sales tax on April 1, he said that it should run its course by the end of June.
He added that, in sectors aside from consumer electronics, department stores and cars, the fall-off in consumer spending should be over by the end of May.
